deadline.value: Fall applications for the Biology PhD are due January 31.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE is mentioned for biology.

supervisor.value: A biology faculty member must agree to supervise you before admission.
supervisor.quote: A Biology faculty member must agree to supervise the student

funding.value: Memorial describes competitive funding packages; admission also needs adequate funds, and the PhD is listed at $23,500 a year.
funding.quote: Memorial University offers competitive funding packages to academically eligible full-time graduate students, both Canadian and international, in all eligible research programs

entry_route.value: Admitted PhD students normally hold a biology master's or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: Students admitted to the PhD program normally hold a biology M.Sc. degree (or equivalent)

notes: Marine Biology (MSc, PhD, no set deadline) and Cognitive and Behavioural Ecology (MSc, PhD, Jan 31) are separate programs, so they are not saved here; the biology page says CABE and ENVS applicants must apply to those programs directly.
